name: cheesybeez-cloud
description: The cloud copy of every shop's events (SCRUM-61), on Cloudflare Workers + D1.

scripts.deploy:staging: npm --prefix .. run build:cloud && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply cheesybeez-cloud-staging --remote --env staging
scripts.answers: wrangler d1 execute cheesybeez-cloud --remote --json --command "SELECT id, saved_at, body FROM owner_answers ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1"
